seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Lights-out board on an 8-cell grid; only ACTION6 clicks have an effect.
Clicking a tile toggles color_14<->color_15.
Clicking an operator toggles its marker_14<->marker_15 and every tile orthogonally adjacent at +-8; glyph neighbours stay as they are.
Glyphs, empty cells and other actions are no-ops (static scenery). The rule is stateless.
Unconfirmed: win or level-end behaviour, which never appears in the data.
